Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-english-main-0-prompt-medium-0039-reverse-10", "row_sha256": "7b0dce43f6dd08737706f6f531bc7d44ee119da5d91b28a1063461a74970d2c3", "mode": "/prompt", "language": "en", "context": {}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Organize the supplied request into a clear prompt. Preserve scope and constraints. Do not invent context, requirements, or missing information. Do not perform the task.", "input": "\ncould you put together a friendly reminder for the seed exchange, addressed to Jasper not Celeste. it’s happening sunday may 18, from 9:30 to noon, at Cedar Ridge Community Garden. the message should say that people can bring seeds to swap at the shared table, and they should be in sealed packets with the seed type, variety, and year collected written on them. mention that it’s fine to come without seeds to trade too, since people can still take a packet. keep it concise but include the time and place clearly, and make it sound welcoming rather than formal. please make this just a reminder about the exchange, not a general announcement for other garden events. don’t address it to anyone else; Jasper, not Celeste is the recipient.", "output": "Write a concise, friendly reminder for the seed exchange addressed to Jasper, not Celeste. The exchange is on Sunday, May 18, from 9:30 a.m. to noon at Cedar Ridge Community Garden. Mention that people can bring seeds to swap at the shared table in sealed packets labeled with the seed type, variety, and year collected. Note that people are welcome even if they have no seeds to trade, since they can still take a packet. Make the time and place clear, use a welcoming rather than formal tone, and keep the message focused on this exchange rather than other garden events."}]
